id: validation-Instance-Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-6

pointer.content:
Test Case 6: Backend Sync Enforcement (Dual-Write Pattern)

Input:
  - Analyze opencode source code statically
  - Check for backend sync calls in storage operations

Expected Output:
  - hasImpulseBackendSync: true (impulse_create calls metabob_impulse_store)
  - hasActivitySaveBackendSync: true (Activity.save calls metabob_activity_save)
  - hasActivityLoadBackendFallback: true (Activity.load has metabob_activity_load fallback)
  - hasDirectHTTP: false (no direct fetch/axios calls to rpc-api)
  - hasRequiredImports: true (imports MCP and Instance modules)

Validation:
  - Read impulse-create.ts and verify metabob_impulse_store call
  - Read activity.ts and verify metabob_activity_save in save()
  - Read activity.ts and verify metabob_activity_load in load()
  - Grep for direct HTTP calls (should find none)
  - Verify MCP.clients() usage pattern
